## Bio

I'm a PhD Student at the Centre for Microbiome Research in Brisbane, Australia.
I have an enormous passion for biology and informatics, which allows me to
create a perfect balance and explore the maximum of my capabilities, while doing
two things I have an tremendous interest in. Trying to keep on learning and
improving is one of my personal mottoes, in the endless journey of creating a
wiser and better version of myself.

<!-- On this site I keep a list of my projects, as well as my CV and a technical and personal [blog](blog). -->
On this site I keep my CV and a blog. If you want to check out my work, you can take a look at my [GitHub](https://www.github.com/areias03) profile.

## Research Interests

- **Systems Biology:** metabolic engineering, community modelling, computational dynamics of complex systems and simulating interactions
- **Microbiology:** how small life forms can produce outcomes with higher orders of impact in ecosystems, with special focus in human health
- **Metabolomics:** linking genotype, phenotype and metabolic activity to overall function in small and large-scale biological systems
- **Machine-Learning:** data-driven predictions for behaviour, role categorization and designing models with applications in medicine
